sources.title: MedQwen: Sparse Spectral LoRA for Medical VLMs
sources.snippet: MedQwen is a parameter-efficient medical VLM that uses spectrally routed LoRA experts to improve robustness across heterogeneous medical datasets and to reduce catastrophic forgetting. Optimization with SVD-structured MoE by separately aligning each expert.
